headline: Government files SEBI takeover disclosure for Engineers India Limited under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas filed a substantial acquisition disclosure on behalf of the President of India in respect of Engineers India Limited, triggering SEBI takeover reporting requirements under Regulation 31(4) of the Takeover Regulations, 2011.
detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE on 2 July 2026 by Neha Sharma, Section Officer (Oil Refinery) at the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, on behalf of the President of India. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 requires disclosure when a person acquires shares triggering the thresholds under Regulations 3 or 4 (typically 25% or more). No additional detail on the acquiring entity, shareholding percentage, consideration, or transactional structure is available from public corroborating sources as of 7 July 2026.
